scope: Project-level developments that materially change how the El Paso–Santa Teresa electrician signal should be interpreted.

signals.title: Microgrid construction still awaits the air permit; hearing moves to December 7
signals.summary: Searchlight New Mexico reports that construction has not started on the fuel-cell microgrid and that the air-permit hearing is now scheduled to begin December 7. The earlier November 23 decision deadline is no longer operative.
signals.labor_readthrough: This is a power-system schedule risk, not evidence that campus construction stopped. Local 583 calls should be read alongside the active building work and separately from the unstarted microgrid scope.

signals.title: Developers report 4,400 full-time workers and more than 30% campus completion
signals.summary: During the October 13 site tour, STACK said 4,400 construction workers were working full time, including 1,200 New Mexicans and more than 600 Doña Ana County residents. Developers said the campus was over 30% complete and hiring continued.
signals.labor_readthrough: This is direct evidence of a large active build, but it covers all trades rather than electricians alone. The Local 583 series remains the narrower read on visible electrical hiring pressure.

signals.title: New Mexico challenges the federal review of the Green Chile pipeline
signals.summary: The New Mexico Attorney General told federal regulators that the environmental review for the proposed gas-supply pipeline was inadequate. Federal pipeline approval remains a critical dependency for the planned fuel-cell microgrid.
signals.labor_readthrough: The filing increases uncertainty around later-stage power delivery. It does not by itself imply a slowdown in present building or electrical work at the campus.
signals.source_name: New Mexico DOJ filing at FERC

signals.title: Oracle sends force-majeure notice while maintaining the 2028 schedule
signals.summary: Oracle sent Project Jupiter's developer a force-majeure notice that could defer payments if the campus misses its 2028 in-service target. Oracle says Project Jupiter remains on its planned schedule, and Blue Owl says the notice does not change the project's financial commitments.
signals.labor_readthrough: This raises execution and timing risk, but it is not evidence of a construction stop. Read any Local 583 decline alongside direct contractor and site evidence.
